notes.title: Remake of My Light In The Dark is out now!
notes.content:
Relight The Dark is a chilling and emotionally charged short horror experience that tells a story about a girl living with her abusive mother. 

Remade with some changes, the story is darker, scarier, and more impactful. Enter the darkness... If you dare.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590050/Relight_The_Dark/]Relight The Dark[/url]
